lifecycle: Compose visible UI between cui_begin_frame and cui_end_frame each frame. The context retains focus, resources and transient routing; explicit application models retain data, not an application widget tree.

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool expansion values and optional per-panel cui_disclosure_motion arrays.
components.interaction: Returns whether expansion changed; cui_disclosure_panel_fn composes panel children and cui_disclosure_header_fn custom headers.
components.usage: Submit stable item IDs and caller-owned expansion each frame. Use the presenter for shared sizes, responsive width and SVG indicators. Set joined for one outer card and use appearance for inherited titles, trigger boxes and divider styles. Use the title-states presenter for optional hover, keyboard-focus and press title layers. Retained C and the language builders copy title states through a separately probed setter. Retain motion through end_frame. Retained C and the language builders copy heading layers and divider styles through optional setters and deliver queued change records.
components.name: Accordion

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state, cui_dialog_layout_v1 and child data through end_frame; callback tokens are borrowed only during the active callback.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: For intrinsic first-frame sizing, retain surface plus dialog layout, open with cui_dialog_open_v1, resolve current sizing, and submit six independent slots with cui_dialog_compose_v1 or its Base counterpart. Keep storage through end_frame; old surface/alert helpers remain unchanged. Held-input reset, Root/host and foreign slot builders remain separate limitations.
components.name: AlertDialog

components.state_ownership: Caller optionally retains a bool visible flag referenced by cui_alert_options.visible.
components.interaction: Returns dismissal; writes supplied visibility.
components.usage: Submit the current title/message and visibility; handle dismissal in the returned event branch.
components.name: Alert

components.state_ownership: Immediate C callers retain cui_attachment_state and own resource lifetime. The retained C bridge owns slots and child handles. The application owns file operations and lifecycle state.
components.interaction: Immediate C reports actions and can call typed observers. Retained C and the Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go and Rust builders opt into Open, Remove and Retry through the shared queue. Language builders read the action and optional evidence through the manual component notification poll. In retained C and all five language builders, slot children keep ordinary control events.
components.usage: Submit transfer status and progress. Handle removal and retry in action callbacks. Use cui_attachment_with_metadata for one-line grapheme ellipsis, full labels and typography in immediate C. Retained C and the Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go and Rust builders can copy layout and text options and a decoded RGBA8 preview through separate bridge capabilities. Retained progress is a fraction in [0,1]. Retained C can create preview fallback, overlay, metadata and action containers using cui_bridge_attachment_slot_create_v1. Python, JavaScript and TypeScript expose attachment_slot. Go uses AttachmentSlot. Rust uses App::create_attachment_slot. Each binding probes the provider independently.
components.name: Attachment

components.state_ownership: Caller retains name, borrowed RGBA pixels, bounded circular cache and destination storage through rendering. Optional typed placeholder state and mask versions also survive draw completion; named SVG uses the context cache. Metrics and palettes are copied values.
components.interaction: Interactive avatars return activation; interactive stacks return the selected index or SIZE_MAX. Application opens the selected profile.
components.usage: Initialize a circular image cache once; submit borrowed image pixels with a revision. Missing/invalid images fall back to initials; stacks use stable application keys. Opt into shared design sizes, deterministic identity palettes or anonymous SVG placeholders without changing legacy defaults.
components.name: Avatar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns counts, options, child state and configured Icon state. Content is synchronous; Icon masks outlive rendering. Style/constraints are borrowed during submission.
components.interaction: Child controls return their own actions; corner indicators provide nonfocusable status semantics.
components.usage: Use cui_badge_ex for count/dot/named-icon composition; use cui_badge_with_icon with caller-owned Icon state/options for configured artwork. Handle icon_error independently from composition admission and Core frame success.
components.name: Badge

components.state_ownership: Caller owns child data; no separate bubble model.
components.interaction: Child controls handle their own events.
components.usage: Begin the surface, compose child controls, then end it in the same frame.
components.name: Bubble

components.state_ownership: Caller owns application data and options. Button style callbacks/user are borrowed through submission; surface shadow arrays are copied by value, bounded to eight layers; no callback/list persists across frames.
components.interaction: Returns true on activation; invoke the application action in that branch.
components.usage: For Save, call save_document only when cui_button returns true. content is a composition callback, not an action handler.
components.name: Button

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool or cui_check_state value; context owns focus.
components.interaction: Returns true when the caller-owned value changes.
components.usage: Pass the current value by pointer and persist preferences in the change branch.
components.name: Checkbox

components.state_ownership: Host retains backend and application owns clipboard buffers; cui_platform carries portable callbacks.
components.interaction: Clipboard reads/writes are host interface calls, not a rendered widget action callback.
components.usage: Obtain the host clipboard interface and supply it to editing/copy controls; compose a Copy button to trigger application copying.
components.scope: host adapter facility; no standalone styled clipboard widget
components.name: Clipboard

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool expansion values and optional per-panel cui_disclosure_motion arrays.
components.interaction: Returns whether expansion changed; cui_disclosure_panel_fn composes panel children and cui_disclosure_header_fn custom headers.
components.usage: Submit a stable ID and caller-owned expansion each frame. Use the presenter for shared sizes, responsive width, SVG indicators and trigger feedback. Pass appearance for responsive title typography and state-specific boxes. Use the title-states presenter for optional hover, keyboard-focus and press title layers. Retained C and the language builders copy title states through a separately probed setter. Retain motion through end_frame. Retained C and the language builders copy heading layers through optional setters and deliver queued change records.
components.name: Collapsible

components.state_ownership: Caller retains menu tree state and menu entries; style descriptors copy at entry, while pure style callbacks and userdata are synchronously borrowed. Metadata descriptors copy at entry; custom name bytes remain borrowed and immutable through submission, then Core retains frame copies.
components.interaction: cui_dropdown_button_result separates main activation from menu interaction; styled entries preserve the same Base/events reduction and legacy callback mutations. Metadata names/order apply before existing callbacks; skip-tab does not suppress pointer/AT eligibility.
components.usage: Use independent optional metadata for UTF-8 accessible names, signed tab ordering and skip-tab. NULL/zero preserves legacy behavior. Checked/value matches the existing Button convention; optional toggled presence and language-builder facades remain gaps.
components.name: DropdownButton

components.state_ownership: Caller owns title and description.
components.interaction: Borrowed content callbacks can submit buttons and handle their activation events.
components.usage: Compose optional media/title/description header, content and appended children. Child callbacks submit ordinary native controls.
components.name: Empty

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_overlay with modal=true; context retains focus routing/restoration.
components.interaction: Overlay update handles dismissal/focus; child controls return their own events.
components.usage: Open a modal overlay, submit children inside its active scope and close via application actions.
components.name: Focus Trap

components.state_ownership: Caller owns title and child data; no group model.
components.interaction: Child controls handle their own events.
components.usage: Pair begin/end around application-composed children.
components.name: GroupBox

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_hover_state for delay/open lifecycle.
components.interaction: Hover, focus and escape update the open model. Optional synchronous observers report aggregate open-state transitions, independently of composition admission or actual visibility.
components.usage: Submit the trigger first. Zero height fits wrapped children within the viewport and requests a follow-up when the fitted height changes. A positive height stays fixed. content_revision is an optional placement refresh. With event facades, inspect changed separately from control_result; end HoverCard only when control_result is true. Handlers are borrowed for the call and are not retained across delay or omission. Explicit TAP_TOGGLE accepts the submitted trigger result. LEGACY uses conservative outside taps and a retained contact workspace; RAW_PRIMARY uses unconsumed primary releases outside previous valid content bounds, with no matching down or movement threshold. Raw mode needs no contact. Accepted activation uses entry-open after release; disabled/Escape/placement retain precedence.
components.name: HoverCard

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_icon_state for custom SVG/resource preparation; named helper uses context resources.
components.interaction: cui_icon_loader_fn resolves SVG resources; no click callback.
components.usage: Initialize custom icon state, load data/name/path, submit each frame and destroy prepared resources after use.
components.name: Icon

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_image_state and owns loader/resource backing storage.
components.interaction: cui_image_loader_fn resolves resources; cui_image_result reports load status, not a click event.
components.usage: Submit a source and loader each frame; retain loaded frame resources for their documented paint lifetime.
components.name: Image

components.state_ownership: Caller owns shortcut text and optional formatting buffer.
components.interaction: Presentation only; shortcut dispatch belongs to the application.
components.usage: Submit typed single-stroke hints; compose several as ordinary row children. Host shortcut registration remains separate.
components.name: Kbd

components.state_ownership: Caller owns label text.
components.interaction: Optional semantic control association; presentation has no action callback.
components.usage: Compose secondary text, Unicode highlights and private scalar masking with cui_label_options; the plain wrapper remains available.
components.name: Label

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_marker_state and child descriptors; owns animation time.
components.interaction: cui_status_render_fn paints rich content; no action callback.
components.usage: Supply elapsed time/loading status and compose children using resolved style and opacity.
components.name: Marker

components.state_ownership: Caller owns message data and slot content.
components.interaction: cui_message_render_fn composes slots; action controls inside slots supply events.
components.usage: Submit body and slot options each frame; compose application actions in designated slots.
components.name: Message

components.state_ownership: Caller retains allocated cui_message_scroller_state and message data; destroy model after use.
components.interaction: Row render callbacks compose visible messages; optional cui_message_scroller_handler observes final double offsets and following-tail policy, offset before tail, after legacy composition.
components.usage: Retain state and records through frame completion. Use cui_message_scroller_events for aggregate applied notifications; explicit mutators stay result-only and returned change flags do not replay callbacks.
components.name: MessageScroller

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_notification_state, entry storage, notification content/user pointers and host binding.
components.interaction: cui_notification_callback handles click/close/action; cui_notification_send_fn delegates system delivery to host.
components.usage: Push on an application event, render the stack once after content and honor its wake deadline. Use cui_notifications_responsive for a wrapped card with Close available before hover.
components.name: Notification

components.state_ownership: Caller retains size_t page.
components.interaction: Returns the page-change result and optionally notifies a synchronous aggregate observer.
components.usage: Use cui_pagination_ex with cui_pagination_options for named or custom control heights, responsive rows, a numbered window with optional jump menus, localized labels, hover hints for chevrons and themed button states.
components.name: Pagination

components.state_ownership: Caller owns the target fraction, host clock and optional zero-initialized cui_progress_motion.
components.interaction: Presentation only; the extended return reports whether another animation frame is needed.
components.usage: Submit the controlled fraction each frame; use cui_progress_defaults for the source loading cycle and retain motion state for smooth value changes. Circles need caller-owned pixel storage retained through rendering.
components.name: Progress

components.state_ownership: Keep one selected ID and cui_radio_group_state per group. A controlled standalone radio takes an owner-held bool. The legacy standalone API uses a shared integer. For animated marks, keep zero-initialized cui_radio_group_motion per group or cui_radio_motion per standalone option. For a tooltip, keep one zero-initialized cui_radio_tooltip_state per option in immediate C. The retained C bridge owns its option tooltip state and copies the hint.
components.interaction: cui_radio_group resolves controlled callback requests before painting and provides arrow/Home/End navigation with one Tab stop. cui_radio_events sends select-only boolean requests for unchecked options. Legacy standalone functions return true when selection changes. Optional signed tab ordering in immediate C and the retained C bridge keeps the group as one stop.
components.usage: Submit stable unique item IDs. With cui_radio_events, update the bool in the handler and request a frame to show the change. Use cui_radio_group_present or cui_radio_present with motion storage, and schedule its next frame on the host clock. Use cui_radio_group_present_with_content to add descriptions and decorative label content to grouped options. Attach optional tooltips to the standalone presentation or the group item content descriptor. In retained C, use cui_bridge_radio_set_tooltip_v1 with a Radio or direct RadioGroup Item. Use cui_bridge_radio_set_tab_index_v1 on a retained Radio or RadioGroup. Use cui_bridge_radio_set_paint_v1 to set copied layers on a retained Radio, RadioGroup or direct Item.
components.name: Radio

components.state_ownership: Caller retains float rating.
components.interaction: Returns true when the committed rating changes. Use the typed change callback or the bool result for side effects. Hover preview affects paint only.
components.usage: Pass the application-owned rating by pointer. Use the styled presenter for shared sizes, custom SVG masks, tint and optional step-down behavior. Configure a retained C Rating node with cui_bridge_rating_configure_v1.
components.name: Rating

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_shimmer_state through end_frame and supplies elapsed time.
components.interaction: Presentation only; no action callback.
components.usage: Submit text, timing and reduced-motion preference; honor animation wake deadlines.
components.name: Shimmer

components.state_ownership: Caller owns phase for the legacy route, or one persistent loading motion per placeholder and an owned palette for fixed and responsive painting. Easing userdata is borrowed synchronously. Reset motion explicitly to restart. The retained C bridge copies configuration and owns motion per configured node.
components.interaction: Decorative presentation adds no action, focus or busy semantics. Optional easing runs synchronously during sampling; application loading semantics remain separate.
components.usage: Use cui_skeleton_present for full/fraction/flex sizing. The profile demo combines a fixed circle, fractional text bars and a full-width block. Retain independent motion, schedule the earliest absolute wake and replace placeholders with content when the application finishes loading. For fixed-size painting, use cui_skeleton_ex or cui_skeleton_with_palette.
components.name: Skeleton

components.state_ownership: Caller owns persistent motion state, the monotonic host clock and reduced-motion preference. Optional size descriptors and callback userdata are borrowed through submission.
components.interaction: Decorative presentation; paint/ease callbacks customize appearance and phase, with no action callback or implicit busy semantics.
components.usage: Submit cui_spinner_ex each frame while loading and schedule result.next_wake_seconds; zero deadline means idle. Use a custom paint callback for another SVG icon. Optional cui_spinner_sizing preserves named rem versus custom pixels; finite eased turns may exceed [0,1], reduced motion evaluates ease(0), and nonfinite easing rejects atomically.
components.name: Spinner

components.state_ownership: Caller owns step descriptors and size_t active step.
components.interaction: Legacy reducer updates the active index; additive navigation requests let the application validate and choose the next submitted index.
components.usage: Submit step descriptors and the current step; validate application data before progressing elsewhere. Use the presentation facade for fill connectors with caller-chosen orientation.
components.name: Stepper

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool value and optional cui_switch_state motion.
components.interaction: Returns activation/change; cui_boolean_change_fn receives requested value when on_change is set, leaving acceptance to the caller.
components.usage: Accept or reject requested changes in a synchronous on_change callback; resubmit the accepted value next frame.
components.name: Switch

components.state_ownership: Caller owns tag text/content; no tag model.
components.interaction: Presentation only; child controls provide actions.
components.usage: Use the text helper or pair successful begin/end and apply returned foreground/font style to children.
components.name: Tag

components.state_ownership: Caller retains bool pressed value.
components.interaction: Returns activation/change; optional cui_boolean_change_fn receives the requested value.
components.usage: Keep the authoritative bool in application state; on_change may validate before accepting.
components.name: Toggle

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_hover_state for delay/open lifecycle.
components.interaction: Hover, focus and escape update the open model. Optional synchronous observers report aggregate open-state transitions, independently of composition admission or actual visibility.
components.usage: Submit the trigger first. With event facades, inspect changed separately from control_result; end HoverCard only when control_result is true. Handlers are borrowed for the call and are not retained across delay or omission.
components.name: Tooltip

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_calendar_state and cui_date_selection.
components.interaction: cui_calendar_result reports aggregate selection/navigation; live cui_date_disabled_fn excludes dates. Presentation and behavior extensions have no typed observer bridge or binding options; legacy CHANGE remains selection-only.
components.usage: Initialize caller state and submit each frame. Optional cui_calendar_ex enables month access, host-supplied today and neighboring cells; cui_calendar_with_behavior adds independent range transition, endpoint validation, year destination and recenter policies. Zero options preserve exact legacy behavior. Rebuild with matching headers/library.
components.name: Calendar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_color_state and cui_color value. ColorEntry owns an address-stable, noncopyable bounded draft/editor; destroy after render consumption. Float-HSLA entry separately retains normalized full-precision selection/preview and an address-stable owned editor.
components.interaction: Returns true when color changes. Additive ColorEntry separates draft/preview/commit and summarizes accepted Enter commits after submission; owner sync is silent and conflict-aware. Float-HSLA entry preserves owner floats until explicit hex parsing; SELECT requests close without owning a popup.
components.usage: Submit persistent channel/editor state; use the accepted color in the next frame theme or preview.
components.name: ColorPicker

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit query/buffer, popup state, items, selection and filtered scratch array with capacity at least the item count.
components.interaction: cui_combobox_result distinguishes query and selection behavior.
components.usage: Retain the query editor and popup; filter application choices using the query and process returned changes.
components.name: Combobox

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_date_picker_state and cui_date_selection. DateTime uses separately initialized cui_date_time_picker_state plus cui_date_time_value; both are owner-thread/context local.
components.interaction: Returns final selection changes; live cui_date_disabled_fn restricts dates. The extended API forwards Calendar presentation/behavior and preserves final-queue completion close/focus; legacy CHANGE wrappers do not accept the extension or observe lifecycle.
components.usage: Initialize stable popup identity once; submit caller state and selection each frame. Optional cui_date_picker_ex forwards month/today/neighbor presentation and independent range/year/recenter policies. Zero extension preserves legacy behavior, including late-error bool; rebuild matching headers/library. The separate date-only actions facade adds bounded presets, an optional clear button and explicit Delete scope with retained child selection; language builders omit it. Optional cui_date_time_picker is a separate single civil date/time model with retained time, explicit assignment, bounded presets/clear and one-reduction Styled composition; Base helpers submit semantics inside caller-owned popup. No timezone/range/chrono parser, typed callback stream or binding facade is provided. The DatePicker gallery has an explicit single-date Date + time mode with desktop/touch segment editing, presets/clear and copyable C11 snippet; turning it off retains the date in legacy/actions modes.
components.name: DatePicker

components.state_ownership: Application retains the multiline edit, visual-row workspace, editor/search state, matcher ranges, query/replacement edit models and optional replacement scratch. Multicursor editing also borrows live selections, history snapshots and cursor anchors; adapters borrow this storage.
components.interaction: cui_editor returns edit, selection and scroll results; retained search supports ASCII-insensitive navigation and atomic replacement. Optional multicursor interaction supports adding cursors, measured navigation, selection painting, atomic typing and undo/redo; cui_editor_highlight_fn supplies syntax colors.
components.usage: Initialize editor and optional search resources once, call cui_editor_find_bar every frame, and pass the same matcher in cui_editor_options.search for visible match highlights. Attach selection storage with cui_edit_attach_selections and initialize borrowed anchors with cui_editor_multicursor_init to enable multicursor interaction. Keep replacement scratch disjoint from model storage.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: Editor

components.state_ownership: Caller owns field descriptors, labels, validation messages and each control value/model.
components.interaction: cui_form_content_fn composes field controls; those controls supply action/change events.
components.usage: Describe associations and validation in fields; submit controls in content callbacks and handle their events there.
components.name: Form

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit and its backing buffer; cui_input_ex additionally uses caller-owned cui_input_state.
components.interaction: cui_input_result reports changed, submitted, rejected and errors. Optional whole-value validate callback decides whether a proposed edit is accepted. Checked pattern and number formatting use caller-owned workspace and commit as one Undo step.
components.usage: Retain the editor across frames. Use width = -1 inside a sized parent so the caret follows live resize. Read the laid-out offset with cui_input_scroll_x after the frame.
components.name: Input

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit, cui_input_group_state, and addon descriptors.
components.interaction: cui_input_group_result reports edit behavior; cui_input_group_content_fn composes addons. Opt-in observers report accepted addon activations and per-event nested text changes/submissions; results never replay callbacks.
components.usage: Keep the editor and state across frames and compose prefix/suffix addon controls.
components.name: Input Group

components.state_ownership: Caller retains double value, cui_number_state and its borrowed cui_edit editor/buffer.
components.interaction: cui_number_result reports changed/submitted/invalid; cui_number_step_fn customizes stepping.
components.usage: Retain editor draft across frames; consume submitted/changed separately from invalid input.
components.name: NumberInput

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_otp_state and initialized character buffer.
components.interaction: cui_otp_result distinguishes changed and completion events.
components.usage: Initialize bounded storage once, submit cells each frame and consume the returned completion event.
components.name: OtpInput

components.state_ownership: Caller retains question definitions, state and all workspace buffers. An attached observer, handler/userdata and disjoint frame arenas remain alive through detach and all in-flight callbacks; rebuild matching headers/library after the state pointer ABI extension.
components.interaction: cui_questionnaire_event_fn emits live legacy model events; cui_questionnaire_validate_fn validates answers. The optional persistent typed observer runs synchronously before each legacy callback with frozen bounded copied payloads; handlers are observational and input metadata is UNKNOWN.
components.usage: Initialize definitions/workspace once; compose current controls each frame and handle answer/submit events. Optional masked slot styles refine boxes; six localized labels override defaults. Rebuild consumers after changing the by-value options ABI. Additive keyboard policies offer OFF/letters/numbers, item-only answer entry and host-selected Control/Meta submission; zero preserves legacy routing. Language builders omit these policies. Pure answer/submission snapshots copy effective values into caller-owned bounded storage without callbacks or model mutation; query_copy reports scalar state. Language builders omit snapshot APIs. Optional typed observation freezes Completed/Submit as one pair, preserves legacy callback replacement and nested mutations, and reports capacity/depth failures without suppressing legacy events. Detach can return BUSY while an outer callback pins resources. Language builders omit observer attachment, typed payloads and arenas. Additive progress presentation supports masked localized accessible/visible labels, borrowed decorative child composition and explicit bounded text size/linebox/style/color; zero preserves legacy paint and enabled-position numeric semantics. No implicit typography cascade or language-builder progress facade is provided. Additive named Title/Description/ChoiceDescription and decorative Error content use independent LEGACY/TOKENS text policies and masked text refinements. Zero extracts legacy text metrics and preserves Error paint; separate text wrappers do not recreate heading gap automatically. Four-size token tiers are source-derived; shared design-size proportional tiers are CUI extensions. Schema parts need an Item container for active/disabled gating; Error keeps one localized Alert. Callbacks are borrowed, pure and C-only; no family style cascade or model events are added. Additive independent geometry exposes five masked container/card patches, checked full numeric metrics and borrowed extended choice renderers. NULL/zero retains the exact legacy path; numeric values never implicitly cascade. Shared design size wins over custom scalar, then explicit masks win. Minimum blank area shares the real card hit/focus/semantic ID; fixed overflow and ancestor clipping remain ordinary Core behavior. Default choice text refinements stay inside the existing reducer. Input asymmetric padding/editor style, Button/trailing actions, Form role, arbitrary Styled and language-builder geometry remain required followups.
components.name: Questionnaire

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_choice_popup, selected cui_id and item array.
components.interaction: Returns selection change; choice content/render callbacks customize presentation.
components.usage: Initialize popup once; submit trigger and selected value each frame.
components.name: Select

components.state_ownership: Caller retains float value and supplies min/max/step. Optional palette values own all colors and two gradient stops; no borrowed storage. Optional typed model values/domain/state own pointer-free doubles. Optional style plans own source metrics and background brush values; the pure resolver does not render or submit a Styled widget. The C-only Base route borrows callback/user/strings synchronously, keeps confirmed entry immutable and evolves requested intent; acceptance explicitly updates external owner storage. The C Styled facade owns separate ring motion and rejects visible V1 gradient thumbs before reduction. The opt-in Linux C adapter forwards AT-SPI Set Value to typed Slider thumbs. The C bridge kind81 owns reducer/presentation state and a copied request FIFO; explicit receipt acceptance updates a full double Single/Range pair after step without legacy CHANGE. The Python and Node/TypeScript controlled builders own frozen copied requests and receipt tokens; callbacks run after legacy dispatch, with explicit full-pair acceptance. Go controlled builders return owned value copies with private receipt authority; all controlled bridge callbacks require explicit full-pair acceptance. Rust controlled builders own copied typed requests and local receipt tokens; restricted HRTB callbacks receive a borrowed request context after legacy dispatch and accept full pairs explicitly. Rust App remains !Send/!Sync; close requests shutdown and Drop destroys.
components.interaction: Legacy scalar route returns true when the value changes; the C-only typed Base route emits ordered proposals and returns passive counts without accepting owner values. Python, Node/TypeScript, Go and Rust use independent after-step FIFOs and never autoaccept.
components.usage: Pass a volume value by pointer; apply audio settings only in the change branch. The browser gallery uses the controlled Single/Range facade with explicit accept/reject, both axes, reverse/log and passive deadlines; its complete callback/init/compose copy code is in web/modules/slider_usage.js. For the opt-in Linux typed Slider host, see docs/NATIVE_ACCESSIBILITY.md. The browser gallery uses V1 painting. Python and Node/TypeScript controlled authoring and complete callback/compose examples are documented in docs/PYTHON_SLIDER_MODEL.md and docs/NODE_SLIDER_MODEL.md; Go owned-value authoring is documented in docs/GO_SLIDER_MODEL.md. Rust owned-value authoring and the restricted callback context are documented in docs/RUST_SLIDER_MODEL.md.
components.name: Slider

components.state_ownership: Caller retains speech state/workspace and recognizer/input implementations.
components.interaction: cui_speech_event_fn reports recognition events; host reports queue messages and application pumps them.
components.usage: Initialize provider bindings, pump recognition on the owning thread and compose button/waveform each frame; dispose after use.
components.name: Speech

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_edit, buffer, cui_textarea_state and line workspace.
components.interaction: cui_textarea_result reports edit events and layout errors. Ctrl+Left/Right and Alt+Left/Right move by word across wrapped rows. Shift extends the selection.
components.usage: Initialize line storage once and submit the multiline editor each frame.
components.name: Textarea

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_time_state and cui_time value; additive localized route retains cui_time_field_state_v1 and immutable borrowed locale/options.
components.interaction: Legacy plain functions return bool after applying edits. V1 returns cui_time_field_result_v1: changed is net value mutation, status is operation outcome and validation is edit validation; optional cui_time_change_fn observes one copied aggregate after Base semantics or Styled submission.
components.usage: Use the ordinary localized route for per-segment Tab and optional IME. The One stop per field gallery mode uses a direct C roster before dispatch. After frame completion use cui_semantic_text_value_v1 to read the ordered field's localized committed value. An accessibility host can use cui_queue_accessibility_action with CUI_ACCESSIBILITY_FOCUS to select an eligible segment for the following ordered frame while logical focus stays on the field. Use either cui_time_handler or changed for any given side effect. Keep state, options and locale resources alive and check status and validation.
components.name: TimeField

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state, geometry workspace and slide data.
components.interaction: cui_carousel_change_fn observes selection; cui_carousel_render_fn composes slides.
components.usage: Initialize capacity once, submit slides each frame and handle selected-index changes separately from slide rendering.
components.name: Carousel

components.state_ownership: Caller owns item descriptors/content; no separate list model.
components.interaction: cui_description_render_fn composes custom values; child controls provide actions.
components.usage: Submit label/value descriptors each frame; respect the resolved layout width in custom content.
components.name: DescriptionList

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state, cui_dialog_layout_v1 and child data through end_frame; callback tokens are borrowed only during the active callback.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: For intrinsic first-frame sizing, retain surface plus dialog layout, open with cui_dialog_open_v1, resolve current sizing, and submit six independent slots with cui_dialog_compose_v1 or its Base counterpart. Keep storage through end_frame; old surface/alert helpers remain unchanged. Held-input reset, Root/host and foreign slot builders remain separate limitations.
components.name: Dialog

components.state_ownership: Application retains cui_dock, cui_dock_view and the panel registry; keep callback data alive through renderer completion.
components.interaction: Panel render callbacks compose active content; on_event reports select, close, reorder, move, split and resize; allow_operation may veto structural actions.
components.usage: Create the model and view once, register stable panel keys, submit cui_dock_view_render each frame and serialize the model between frames.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: Dock

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_list_state, selected cui_id and item array.
components.interaction: Returns changes; cui_choice_activation_fn / cui_choice_confirm_fn / cui_choice_cancel_fn handle list interaction.
components.usage: Keep keys stable; submit current items and selection, then handle activation/confirmation callbacks synchronously.
components.name: List

components.state_ownership: Caller retains menu entries and popup/menu-tree state.
components.interaction: Returns activation and writes the activated cui_id through the action pointer; check/radio entries update caller values. cui_menu_render_fn composes custom content.
components.usage: Initialize menu-tree state once and submit stable entry IDs each frame; invoke application actions from the returned activation and action key.
components.name: Menu

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the surface kind and open from an action. Pair end only when begin succeeds. On the opening action, applications may use cui_focus for an enabled child in that successful frame. Call cui_popover_link_trigger after the trigger and panel with the current begin result, or false when omitted. Choose CUI_POPOVER_OUTSIDE_FOCUS_KEEP_POINTER with an outside-focus begin function to preserve existing pointer focus on accepted nonmodal outside dismissal. Other closes restore the trigger. Consume result once. Use cui_popover_begin for explicit anchor/offset/arrow positioning. Arrow rendering requires a mesh-capable adapter; SDL3 and browser adapters support bounded analytic meshes with documented limits. Call cui_popover_take_secondary_press after submitting an enabled trigger to opt into right-click handling. The gallery shows outside dismissal and both trigger modes in legacy and source anchor placements. Source anchors expose all eight popup anchors, signed custom gap, arrow toggle, app/host reference rem and edge clamping. The complete C11 snippet follows the current mode.
components.name: Popover

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state, slots and panel descriptors.
components.interaction: Mouse and touch drag the handle. The focused separator responds to arrow keys. cui_resizable_resize_fn observes completed resizes.
components.usage: Initialize slot storage, submit panel descriptors within a feasible combined min/max range every frame and save sizes after completed resizes.
components.name: Resizable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_root, plugin instance storage, registry and bound surface/notification storage.
components.interaction: cui_root_content_fn composes application content; cui_root_copy_fn handles copy; plugins have explicit lifecycle hooks.
components.usage: Initialize root/plugin storage, render content and facilities each frame, then dispose after use.
components.name: Root View

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_scroll_state offsets and supplies content/viewport dimensions.
components.interaction: Legacy begin/end reduce scroll input. Optional paired observers report one applied final offset after children and finish; normalization is not evidence of user input.
components.usage: Preserve caller offsets. Base observer begin may return false for a valid no-change pair and must still be finished. Styled observer begin returns admission: end only after true. Handlers are borrowed by finish/end; do not mix pairing layers.
components.name: Scrollable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains page state/workspace, descriptors and actual setting values.
components.interaction: cui_setting_render_fn composes controls; cui_setting_dirty_fn and cui_setting_reset_fn implement application dirty/reset behavior.
components.usage: Initialize page/query storage; submit descriptors and implement each setting through its render/dirty/reset functions.
components.name: Settings

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_surface_state and child form/application data.
components.interaction: cui_surface_decision_fn may veto close; cui_surface_closed_fn observes close; take_result consumes the decision.
components.usage: Initialize the appropriate surface kind, open from an action, and pair end only when begin succeeds. Consume result once.
components.name: Sheet

components.state_ownership: Caller retains sidebar state/cache, entry descriptors and selected application route.
components.interaction: cui_sidebar_content_fn composes regions; menu-item results expose selection/activation.
components.usage: Initialize measurement cache, submit current entries, and update routing from menu-item events. The body reveals newly keyboard-focused mounted rows between pinned regions. Hidden scrollbars return their lane to the rows.
components.name: Sidebar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns left/center/right descriptors and displayed data.
components.interaction: cui_chrome_render_fn composes regions; child controls handle actions.
components.usage: Submit region content each frame; preserve application data outside the bar.
components.name: StatusBar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains selected cui_id, item array and optional motion/scroll state.
components.interaction: Returns selection changes; cui_tab_panel_fn composes selected panel content.
components.usage: Submit tab descriptors and current selected key. For a bounded strip retain scroll state and specify bar_extent. The gallery and SDL3 adapter translate Shift plus vertical-only wheel into horizontal scrolling.
components.name: Tabs

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_theme value and any icon-loader user/backing storage.
components.interaction: cui_theme_icon_loader_fn resolves icon SVG; theme selection is an application event.
components.usage: Choose/copy a preset and pass its address to styled controls; invalidate after changing it. Unreleased cui_background values/sample helpers are pure C-only math. For actual opt-in rendering, use cui_software_query_v2 before Core V2 composition and cui_software_render_v2 afterwards; V1 routes remain unchanged. The other four renderer paths, foreign authoring and all78 part coverage remain pending.
components.scope: application style data; passed during frame submission
components.name: Theme

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_title_bar_state and window interface binding.
components.interaction: on_close callback handles application close; window host functions implement native window behavior.
components.usage: Provide cui_sdl3_window_interface or an equivalent host. Decorated Cocoa windows use native traffic lights; SDL borderless windows use client controls. Keep host/user pointers valid during calls.
components.name: TitleBar

components.state_ownership: Caller owns item/command descriptors and command user data.
components.interaction: cui_toolbar_render_fn composes items; cui_toolbar_command.on_activate handles command activation.
components.usage: Submit command descriptors each frame and perform application actions in on_activate.
components.name: Toolbar

components.state_ownership: Caller retains model/state, selected cui_id and borrowed node/expansion arrays until next successful rebuild.
components.interaction: cui_tree_result separates selection_changed, expansion_changed and activated key.
components.usage: Rebuild preorder data when it changes; submit visible rows each frame and open the activated application item from the result.
components.name: Tree

components.state_ownership: Application retains cui_virtual_list and cui_virtual_widget_state; keyed extents live in the model and row controls remain application-owned.
components.interaction: cui_virtual_render_item_fn composes the visible window; cui_virtual_measure_item_fn supplies intrinsic measurement; optional cui_scroll_handler observes aggregate final offsets after composition, with UNKNOWN source.
components.usage: Capture with cui_virtual_capture_anchor before model updates and apply cui_virtual_restore_anchor before drawing again. Keep keys and extents stable during row callbacks. Use cui_virtual_list_draw_events for final-offset observation; inspect changed separately from delivered change_count and the unchanged deferred control_result. Retained C and all five language builders use complete row projections and optional anchor preservation.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + retained base model
components.name: VirtualList

components.state_ownership: Caller retains cui_chart_state, its RGBA pixel buffer/byte capacity, data arrays and resources used by options.
components.interaction: Hit testing identifies data; tooltip/format/paint callbacks customize output and are not application action callbacks.
components.usage: Submit data/options each frame. For a scaled Line or Area bitmap, convert the desired logical stroke width to bitmap pixels with the scale ratio. With CUI_CHART_LAYOUT_SOURCE_POINT, set show_dots on a Line to add eight-logical-pixel series markers. Route application actions from explicit hit testing or child controls.
components.name: Chart

components.state_ownership: Caller retains command state, row workspace, cui_edit query and command descriptors.
components.interaction: on_select/on_query/on_confirm/on_cancel observe synchronous interaction; command item action invokes application work.
components.usage: Initialize bounded query/row storage, submit entries each frame, and execute actions only from confirmation/action events. Set width=-1 to grow inside a Dialog or other bounded parent.
components.name: Command

components.state_ownership: Caller retains allocated model/state, data rows/columns and any borrowed label storage.
components.interaction: cui_table_result reports interaction; cui_table_label_fn provides accessibility text and cui_table_cell_fn composes visible cells.
components.usage: Bind data when changed, submit virtual cells each frame, and handle selection/sort actions from the result. Capture with cui_table_capture_row_anchor before a live update and apply cui_table_restore_row_anchor after a successful bind. For paging, use result.load_more and a caller-owned in-flight flag while displayed rows stay interactive. Striped body cells alternate in model order and selection takes precedence. Wheel ticks use the Scrollable default of 48 logical pixels; mark pixel deltas scroll_precise. Enabled movable headers own touch reorder; body/nonmovable headers retain pan, and touch drops use indexed clipped-region admission.
components.name: DataTable

components.state_ownership: Caller retains scales, samples, path commands, RGBA pixels, tick labels and callback state; no retained widget tree.
components.interaction: cui_plot_activate_fn receives validated pointer positions. The optional viewport handles Shift-drag, Ctrl-wheel, touch pan and pinch. CUI_PLOT_TOUCH_YIELD_VERTICAL offers unconsumed vertical touch pan to the host when the Y domain cannot move.
components.usage: Reduce the optional viewport before projecting data and bind after submitting the view. Build paths and render into caller-owned pixels. Keep labels and pixels alive through renderer completion.
components.scope: styled frame adapter + standalone numeric model; bounded software rasterizer
components.name: Plot

components.state_ownership: Caller owns row/cell hierarchy and data; no retained table model is required.
components.interaction: Composition only; child controls handle actions.
components.usage: Submit sections, rows and cells using balanced begin/end nesting each frame. Set custom_background and background on a row for custom header fills or alternate body rows.
components.name: Table

components.state_ownership: Caller retains state and all source/rendered/layout workspace buffers.
components.interaction: on_link/open_url handle link interaction; image resolves resources; other content/measurement hooks compose or paint.
components.usage: Initialize bounded workspace, set text on changes, then submit each frame. Decoded link URLs are borrowed only during callbacks: copy for deferred use.
components.name: TextView

core_layout_constraints.scope: Opt-in C Core only: current intrinsic Y allocation with V1 single-body or additive V2 Content/Body peers and a separate intrinsic Footer, standalone Y clamping and real overlay track/thumb geometry. Widths remain independent of allocated Y. Existing Scrollable/Base/Dialog APIs and all five foreign builders remain unchanged; this is not full slot composition or general constraint closure.
core_layout_constraints.capacity: Shared32 body links,64 clamps and64 optional tracks; copied80/144/24/32/48-byte records and distinct offset/bounds destinations borrowed through end_frame. V1-only LP64 base12856 bytes/one resource slot unchanged; V2-only sidecar2560 bytes/one extra slot, combined15416 bytes<=16KiB. Zero-opt-in frames allocate none; omitted resources retain the normal one-frame history.

core_numeric_accessibility.scope: Explicit C Core numeric consumer capability, owned typed SET_VALUE input and current-semantic claim. The typed Slider model and optional Linux adapter use this contract. Legacy controls never opt in automatically. In-frame prior-snapshot readiness is an observer only, not current target eligibility or typed model reduction.
core_numeric_accessibility.capacity: Lazy allocation on first valid nonzero mask only: sizeof private state plus 8*max_elements bytes, including two EVENT_MAX=256 owned scalar sidecars; retained until context destroy.
